Notes:
1. The above Consolidated Financial Results were reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and have been approved and taken on record by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 5th November, 2026.

2.The above Consolidated Financial Results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Ind AS 34, Interim Financial Reporting prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the relevant rules issued thereunder and the other accounting principles generally accepted in India.

3. The Statutory Auditors have carried out Limited Review of the Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th Septermber,2026. An unqualified report has been issued by them thereon.

4. The company has four identified reportable segments viz "Real Estate", "Steel", "Engineering" and ""Electrical", in accordance with Ind AS 108. Thus, the company has done the Segment Reporting, as per Ind AS 108. (Refer "Segment Reporting under Ind AS 108").

5. On August 13, 2026, the Company entered a loan agreement of Rs. 219 Crores with Tata Capital Limited to avail financial assistance for the acquisition of 73,00,000 equity shares of Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited (SISCOL).

6.Tata Capital Limited has assigned a Rs.40 Crores portion of its Rs.219 Crores loan facility to Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) under an Assignment and Transfer Deed dated September 30, 2026. Consequently, ABCL takes over the rights and obligations for this specific Rs.40 Crores tranche under the original Loan Agreement.

7.The Securities and Exchange Board of India has issued a settlement order dated September 29, 2026 (Settlement Order) in connection with the Show Cause Notices dated July 9, 2025. Pursuant to the settlement terms, a total settlement amount of Rs.4.16 Crores was remitted to resolve the proceedings without admitting or denying the findings of fact or conclusions of law.

8.The Rights Issue Committee of the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on January 8, 2026, approved the First and Final Call of Rs.19.50 per Equity Share on 25,44,25,324 partly paid-up Equity Shares issued pursuantto the Rights Issue at an issue price of Rs.39 per Equity Share, comprising Rs.0.50 towards paid-up value and Rs.19.00 towards securities premium. Pursuant to the First and Final Call and subsequent reminders, the Company has received the requisite call money in respect of 25,40,89,772 partly paid-up Equity Shares, while the call money in respect of the remaining 3,35,552 partly paid-up Equity Shares remains outstanding. The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on November 5, 2026, approved the forfeiture of 3,35,552 partly paid-up equity shares due to non-payment of the outstanding First and Final Call Money by the respective shareholders, in accordance with the applicable provisions and terms of issue.

9.The Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Company, at its meeting held on October 16, 2025, approved the grant of stock options under the Lloyds Enterprises Limited Employee Stock Option Plan – 2025 at an exercise price of Rs.2 per option.

This allocation comprised options granted to the eligible employees of the Company and its group companies which included:-
3,75,290 options to the eligible employees of the Company;
8,38,640 options to the eligible employees of Lloyds Realty Developers Limited, a subsidiary of the Company;
1,18,930 options to the eligible employees of Simon Developers & Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd., a step-down subsidiary of the Company; and
60,120 options to the eligible employees of Indrajit Properties Pvt. Ltd., a subsidiary of the Company.

10. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Board vide its Circular Resolution dated October 19, 2026, approved the grant of stock options of 1,35,440 Employee Stock Options under the Lloyds Enterprises Limited Employee Stock Option Plan – 2025 at an exercise price of Rs.2 per option.

This allocation comprised options granted to the eligible employees of the Company and its group companies which included:-
12,250 options to the eligible employees of the Company;
92,790 options to the eligible employees of Lloyds Realty Developers Limited, a subsidiary of the Company;
8,210 options to the eligible employees of Simon Developers & Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd., a step-down subsidiary of the Company; and
22,190 options to the eligible employees of Indrajit Properties Pvt. Ltd., a subsidiary of the Company.

Nomination and Remuneration Committee in its meeting held on September 29, 2026 have approved the allotment of 1,39,298 Equity Shares of face value of Re. 1/- each, to the Lloyds Enterprises Employees Welfare Trust (“Trust”) before exercise of Options by the grantees under Lloyds Enterprises Limited, Employee Stock Option Plan - 2025 (“Scheme”).

12.Pursuant to the Share Purchase, Share Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement dated June 18, 2026, Lloyds Engineering Works Limited (LEWL), a subsidiary of the Holding Company, has acquired equity shares of Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited (SISCOL) as under:a. On August 17, 2026, LEWL allotted 7,00,42,458 equity shares of face value Rs.1/- each at an issue price of Rs.71.25 per share, on a preferential basis for consideration other than cash, against the acquisition of 1,66,35,087 equity shares of SISCOL.b. LEWL acquired 42,44,784 equity shares of SISCOL for cash consideration of Rs.127.34 crore paid to the shareholders of SISCOL.Consequently, SISCOL became a subsidiary of LEWL and a step-down subsidiary of the Holding Company with effect from August 17, 2026. As on September 30, 2026, LEWL holds 2,08,79,871 equity shares (51.13%) of SISCOL. The Holding Company directly holds a further 73,00,000 equity shares (17.88%). The Group's aggregate holding in SISCOL is therefore 69.01% as on September 30, 2026.

13. The consolidated results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 include the results of SISCOL from August 17, 2026. These figures are therefore not comparable with those of the previous periods presented.

14.The figures for the corresponding previous period have been regrouped/reclassified wherever necessary, to make them comparable.

15. Earing Per Share are not annualised except for the year ended 31st March,2026.

16. The results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 are available on the website of BSE at www.bseindia.com, NSE at www.nseindia.com and on Company's website at www.lloydsenterprises.in.
